title: The candidates one source hands to a review round or a findings pass
description: What a finder, an engine or a caller submits through `review-round.mjs add`. The store adds each candidate's `id` and `source`; the submitter never writes them.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root.

line.description: The line on the side named below.

side.description: head: the reviewed tree. base: the tree the change started from, for code the change removed.

summary.description: One sentence: what is wrong. It becomes the claim a verifier checks.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete input or state leading to the wrong output or the damage; for a cleanup, the concrete cost.

verdict.description: Optional: the verdict this candidate already carries from an earlier round or pass.
